references.title: Resolution Width Lifts to Near-Quadratic-Depth Res(⊕) Size
references.source: Electronic Colloquium on Computational Complexity, TR26-018
references.note: Primary lifting theorem used conditionally: base Resolution width w and a constant-size 1-stifling gadget imply Res(⊕) depth Omega(w^2/log S) for size S; MAJ3 is listed as an example.

references.title: Formula Caching in DPLL
references.source: ACM Transactions on Computation Theory 1(3), Article 9
references.note: Primary source formalizing formula caching as FC/CC-style proof systems and separating the operation from the naive identification with ordinary DAG Resolution.
